text:
Alex: RC candidate built: service/api@v2026-rc34 (sha256:fa3b...9c). Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/rc34. Change window tonight 22:00-23:00 PT. Planning promo to prod-canary at 22:05 PT. Need QA + security signoff and ops ack.

deploy-bot: Promotion job queued: rc-promote/rc34 -> prod-canary at 22:05 PT. See /redwoodctl promote logs after kick.

Priya: ran staging smoke at HEAD, most checks green. One flaky background worker NPE in logs, retriable, not blocking for API surface tests. smoke-suite: 42/45 passed.

Lara: security note: We have a tenant KMS key rotation scheduled at 22:10 PT for regional keystores. If we promote at 22:05, some clients might see token verification failures once rotation completes. Recommend either delay promo until after rotation is stable or pin the keystore used by the new deploy for an hour.

Jamal: ops options:
- Option A: Delay promo to 22:40 PT (post-rotation), rerun smoke.
- Option B: Pin rc34 to old-keystore for 60m so tokens remain valid through rotation, then unpin.

I can apply keystore pin with infra command:```bash
redwoodctl config set service/api.keystore=old-tenant-keystore
redwoodctl promote --service service/api --artifact service/api@v2026-rc34 --to prod-canary --meta pin_keystore=old-tenant-keystore
```
This causes the serving runtime to load the pinned keystore for that rollout.

Alex: leaning towards Option B to keep window. Let's delay 35m to give everyone a short buffer. New promo time 22:40 PT. Priya, can you re-run smoke at 22:15 and again at 22:35? Jamal, please prepare rollback steps and make sure the deploy-bot has the fallback artifact pinned (v2026-rc33).

deploy-bot: Promo rescheduled to 22:40 PT by Alex. If health checks fail during rollout, automatic rollback target set to service/api@v2026-rc33. Will post status updates in this thread. :robot_face:

Priya: ACK. I’ll do a quick smoke at 22:15 and full at 22:35. Post any infra commands I need to run.

Jamal: Rollback/rollback-verify snippets:```bash
# rollback to last stable
redwoodctl rollback --service service/api --to service/api@v2026-rc33 --reason "rc34 failed healthchecks"
# clear keystore pin after safe period
redwoodctl config unset service/api.keystore
redwoodctl unpin --service service/api --meta pin_keystore
```
Also monitoring checklist: health-checks (latency p50/p95), request error-rate, auth 401 spike, kv-warm hit rate.

Lara: I’ll watch auth metrics and the KMS rotation logs. If 401s > 0.5% or RSA verify errors appear, I’ll call for immediate rollback.

Alex: release-notes posted and linked above. @deploy-bot please emit final reminder 10m before promo. Thanks everyone.

Priya: quick follow-up: will run smoke and paste results here. Will tag @eng-sre if anything odd.

Jamal: pre-promo checklist done: canary config pin applied in staging, autoscaler limits set, KV warm candidate prepared.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 22:30 PT (10m before promo).

Alex: good. If no major objections, close this thread once promo completes. :thumbsup:
